meta.title: Improve row map assembly
meta.body_summary: Optimize buildRowMap in runtime/vm/vm.go to avoid copying when key/value pairs are already contiguous in memory.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR avoided a copy in buildRowMap but lacked review engagement and was closed by the author after ~67h without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 22 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR but was closed by the author without any review engagement.

review_details.performance_claim: Skip copying in buildRowMap when key/value pairs are already contiguous in memory.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR is a small VM optimization with no benchmark or evidence; it received zero reviews or comments and was closed by the author, illustrating that agent PRs can fail to attract reviewer attention without supporting performance data.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, modified buildRowMap to detect when key/value byte slices are already contiguous in the underlying map and skip copying them to reduce allocations.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All 22 changed lines are in one file with no secondary changes.
change_trajectory: Single commit: modify buildRowMap to conditionally avoid copy when contiguous.
